headings.text: We'll email you once, when your invitation is ready, and for nothing else. Only Mick sees this, and he deletes it whenever you ask.
I use AI and agents to assist, and so if you share your email with me my agents may read it.

How we keep this
              We keep your email and any answers about your computer and coding agent to send your one invitation. Mick and the AI agents he works with can read them.
              They are stored by here.now, this site’s host, until storytree opens to everyone or you ask to be removed, whichever comes first.
              To have your details deleted, message Mick on LinkedIn.
